Welcome!

<br><br>

My name is John Reaves, and I am a PhD candidate in the Department of Economics
at Michigan State University (MSU). I will be on the 2026-2027 job market.

My research interests lie within urban economics, industrial organization, and
public economics, especially how spatial effects play out. My dissertation
primarily focuses on how mobile Internet access changed the retail landscape.
:::
